title: Debt and Safehouse
author: Freya Fairweather
blurb: Cyrus Ravensworth, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
